name: Alpelisib
mechanism: Selective inhibitor of the p110alpha catalytic subunit of PI3K, suppressing signalling in PIK3CA-mutant tumours; used with fulvestrant.
monitoring: Fasting glucose and HbA1c before starting and frequently in early treatment; optimise glycaemic control before initiation
interactions: Avoid strong CYP3A4 inducers and BCRP inhibitors.
resistance: PTEN loss, AKT1 mutations, additional PIK3CA alterations and hyperinsulinaemia-driven pathway reactivation.
